description:
Wall Tuckey Properties are delighted to welcome you to 16 Gracemeadow Court, a beautifully presented three-bedroom mid-terrace property situated in the heart of the thriving village of Stamullen.

Presented in excellent, walk-in condition, this wonderful family home has been lovingly cared for and thoughtfully modernised by its current owners. Deceptively spacious, the property offers a generous combination of bright, contemporary and well-proportioned accommodation throughout.
Among the many features of this impressive home are a BER rating of B, making the property potentially eligible for a Green Mortgage, gas-fired central heating with a boiler installed approximately two years ago, and a superb rear garden complete with a covered pergola, creating an ideal space for outdoor dining and entertaining. White goods are also included in the sale, further adding to the property's appeal as a ready-to-enjoy home.

Stamullen is a popular and thriving village offering an excellent range of local amenities, including primary and secondary schools, shops, a pharmacy and GAA club.The area is particularly well connected for commuters, with a regular bus service operating from the village and Gormanston Train Station approximately a five-minute drive away.Stamullen is approximately 10 minutes from Balbriggan and 20 minutes from Drogheda, while the M1 motorway provides convenient access to the M50, Dublin Airport and Dublin City.

Accommodation
Welcoming entrance hall with wooden flooring and radiator cover.
Bright and comfortable living room featuring carpet flooring, an attractive feature fireplace with wooden surround and a bay window providing excellent natural light.
Spacious kitchen and dining area with wooden flooring and a fully fitted kitchen incorporating a range of wall and floor units. Patio doors provide direct access to the rear garden, creating an excellent connection between the indoor and outdoor living spaces.
Practical utility room with wooden flooring.
Guest WC With tiled flooring and white sanitary suite.
Upstairs;
Landing with carpet flooring, hot press and access to the attic.
Generous master bedroom with wooden flooring and built-in wardrobes.
En-Suite with wooden flooring and white sanitary suite.
Bedroom Two is well-proportioned with carpet flooring.
Bedroom Three with wooden flooring and built-in wardrobes.
Family Bathroom with wooden flooring and white sanitary suite.
The rear garden has been designed with both relaxation and entertaining in mind and features decking with a covered pergola, a patio area and Barna shed. The covered pergola is a particularly attractive addition, providing a sheltered outdoor space that can be enjoyed throughout much of the year.

16 Gracemeadow Court combines modern, comfortable living with an excellent village location and superb transport connections, making it an ideal choice for families, first-time buyers and investors alike.

Viewing is essential and strictly by appointment.
